what: A stamp grid of red circles interspersed with blue triangles, squares and three-line marks walks in a staggered way. Direction differs by even·odd row and by cell (up-right·down-right·up-left·down-left), so each stamp goes one cell horizontally (1.199s power3.inOut) → one cell vertically (same curve) → hops diagonally (1.999s power4.inOut, an arc where the body rises half a cell) while the shape turns 270°. At the end of each step (overlapping by .199s), ten stamps in the center row flip like cards in .1s to show the front of a red ring seal, and return .6s later in .1s. Stamps that leave the board wrap to an invisible cell on the opposite side, so the grid continues endlessly. On hover that stamp grows 1.15× (.2s back.out(2)), on leave .15s power2.out, and pressing fires fx:open (cell type · screen position) — used for the commemorative site’s hero background and the press-to-open contents board

options.cols: Number of cells (horizontal, even), default 14 — below 768 width it uses mobile-cols
options.mobile-cols: Column count below width 768 (even number), default 12
options.area: Cell side = Panel width × area, default .1 (below width 768, mobile-area .23)
options.stamp: Stamp diameter = Panel width × stamp, default .06 (below width 768 mobile-stamp .135)
options.step: Time to walk one cell horizontally or vertically (sec), default 1.199
options.flips: Number of stamps flipped per step, default 10 (0 means none flip)
options.hold: Time the front face shows (sec), default .599
options.mix: Share taken by each of the three non-circle shapes (triangle, square, three lines), default .07

events.fx:open: detail { kind: circle|triangle|square|bars, x, y } — The kind of stamp pressed and its screen position. The receiving side grows a panel from that spot and opens it

parts.face: Name for the flipped front seal (one to three characters). Cycles if there are several. If empty, a default seal mark is used

note: The original draws the hop with MotionPath (curviness 1.5) inside a Konva canvas group rotation (0/180°) and a 135° bundle. To reduce dependencies, the part draws it with a quadratic curve through the same vertices as canvas 2D (half-cell rise) — the arc shape differs very slightly

from.where: index.js stamp grid (Konva) — 14 cells (phone 12), cell .1W · stamp .06W (phone .23W · .135W), 1.199s power3.inOut × 2 + 1.999s power4.inOut hop 270°, ten flip over .1s per step, .599s dwell
